references.label: TMC 10.75.130 block 0
references.quote: (a) No vehicle or combination of vehicles shall be moved or operated on any street or highway within the City when the gross weight on two or more consecutive axles exceeds the limitations prescribed in the following table:

references.label: TMC 10.75.130 block 2
references.quote: Maximum load in pounds carried on any two or more consecutive axles

references.label: TMC 10.75.130 block 3
references.quote: Distance in feet between the extremes of any group of two or more consecutive axles

references.label: TMC 10.75.130 block 256
references.quote: (b) Notwithstanding the provisions of subsection (a) of this section, two consecutive sets of tandem axles may carry a gross load of 34,000 pounds each if the overall distance between the first and last axles is 36 feet or more. (Ord. 19370 § 97, 3-23-10. Code 1995 § 142-748.)
